description: SEO settings for a Total CMS collection. Used as a card sub-schema on the collection meta.

id.label: ID
id.help: Reserved — required by the schema system but unused for cards.

type.label: Structured Data Type
type.help: What objects in this collection are, for og:type and the JSON-LD. Automatic uses the schema default: Blog post for blog and feed schemas, Web page otherwise.

title.label: Title Template
title.help: Composes the title from the object's properties: ${title} | Reviews, ${name} — ${city}. ${site} is the site name. Leave empty to use the object's title. The object's own SEO Title wins.

socialTitle.label: Social Title Template
socialTitle.help: Composes og:title and twitter:title from the object's properties, independent of the Title Template. Leave empty to use the title. The object's own Social Title wins.

description.label: Description Property
description.help: Which property supplies the meta description when the object has no SEO description

image.label: Image Property
image.help: Which image property supplies the social image
